data.answer: Yes. In Australia, patents for pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive an extension beyond the standard 20-year term, providing **up to 25 years of protection**.[1]

citations.quote: The maximum term of a patent is 20 years, though pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive an extension, providing up to 25 years of protection.

claims.text: Australian patents for pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can be extended beyond the standard 20-year term to provide up to 25 years of protection.
